note: Signed addition taken at two widths. Used to fail, on hif-backend#81: hif2verilog dropped `signed` from the ports and widened by zero extension, so -3 + 2 read 15 where the source reads -1. verilog2hif recorded the signedness correctly - the HIF carries signed="true" - so the loss was entirely in the backend, and it was silent: exit 0, valid Verilog, clean reparse, different numbers. Fixed: the ports keep `signed` and widening replicates the sign bit. The corpus was full of arithmetic and had nothing saying an adder knows its operands are signed.
